title: NAS-Driven Hardware Accelerator Exploration for Edge AI and Quantization Effects on the Pareto Space
abstract: arXiv:2608.13293v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Edge AI deployment demands neural architectures that are simultaneously accurate, computationally efficient, and hardware-deployable - a challenge addressed by hardware-aware Neural Architecture Search (NAS). While recent works incorporate quantization directly into the NAS loop, these approaches expand search complexity and tightly couple architecture and quantization design. The simpler post-search quantization strategy has received little analytical attention: the effects of Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) on the NAS-discovered Pareto structure remain uncharacterised, and no framework combines quantized architecture mapping onto reconfigurable accelerators with automated hardware exploration. This paper addresses both gaps. translated_title: 面向边缘AI的NAS驱动硬件加速器探索及量化对帕累托空间的影响
translated_abstract: 边缘AI部署要求神经网络架构同时具备高准确性、计算效率和硬件可部署性——这是一个由硬件感知的神经架构搜索（NAS）所解决的挑战。尽管近期工作将量化直接纳入NAS循环，但这些方法增加了搜索复杂度，并紧密耦合了架构与量化设计。更简单的搜索后量化策略在分析上受到的关注较少：训练后量化（PTQ）对NAS发现的帕累托结构的影响尚未被表征，也没有框架将量化架构映射到可重构加速器并结合自动化硬件探索。本文填补了这两个空白。首先，提出了一个三阶段流水线：基于NAS-Bench-201的硬件无关帕累托排名代理前端、带有帕累托感知过滤和反馈控制的量化桥梁，以及一个进化域空间探索器。
tldr: 本文提出了一种三阶段流水线，首次系统分析了训练后量化对NAS发现的帕累托前沿的影响，并实现了量化架构到可重构加速器的自动化映射与硬件探索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-stage pipeline that systematically analyzes the impact of post-training quantization on NAS-discovered Pareto fronts and enables automated mapping of quantized architectures onto reconfigurable accelerators with hardware exploration.
